answer: Sealed-bid admission auction: each epoch the harbor opens only 100 seats. Each applicant seals a 50-credit bid on a shale ballot and locks a 70-credit timber bond. Bids stay hidden until opened; top 100 pay the clearing price; losing bids burn. Each fake pays 50+70=120, k-th 120+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,117,000 vs a 40,000 pool, and the rented-bid ring fails as every bid needs its own timber bond and shale ballot. Honest agents pay one price.
